key_insight: EasyPPO shows that PPO instability in LLM RL is driven mainly by critic failures, and that stabilizing critic training can improve overall performance.
engineering_relevance: For practical LLM reinforcement learning, the paper suggests more reliable training comes from handling rollout filtering and return-noise imbalance in the critic rather than only tuning the actor.
method: Actor-only overlong filtering: train the critic on returns from both completed and truncated rollouts.
Noise-normalized critic regression: weight each prompt’s critic loss by the inverse standard deviation of its sampled returns.
Use moderately smaller critic mini-batches to limit outlier impact during gradient clipping.
evidence_signal: Across FrontierCS coding, AIME24 mathematical reasoning, and Search-R1 multi-turn search, EasyPPO stayed stable through training and improved best validation scores by 14.89%, 2.28%, and 9.47% over PPO.
watch_item: Smaller critic batches and return-normalized weighting may be sensitive to batch composition and reward-noise estimation, so implementation details matter.
paper_title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key
